ko.title: ML Music Studio — 앱, 웹 도구, 녹음실
ko.description: 사운드 엔지니어를 위한 앱과 무료 웹 도구, 그리고 용산의 녹음·믹싱·마스터링 스튜디오.
ko.h1: 소리를 위한 도구와, 엔지니어가 운영하는 녹음실
ko.sub: 사운드 엔지니어가 직접 만든 앱과 웹 도구, 그리고 녹음·믹싱·마스터링을 하는 작은 스튜디오입니다.

cards.title: 앱
cards.text: 무대음향 시험 대비, SPL·RTA 측정, 귀 훈련, DAW 단축키, 악보 변환까지. 현장에서 쓰려고 만든 앱입니다.

cards.title: 플러그인
cards.text: 곧 선보일 오디오 플러그인(VST3·AU)을 준비하고 있습니다.

cards.title: 녹음실
cards.text: 녹음·믹싱·마스터링·무대음향. 서울 용산의 작업실에서 엔지니어가 직접 작업합니다.

ko.tools_text: RTA 분석기, 신호 발생기, 귀 훈련, 딜레이·음향·전기·템포 계산기를 브라우저에서 바로 쓰세요.

en.title: ML Music Studio — Apps, Web Tools and a Recording Studio
en.description: Apps and free web tools for sound engineers, plus a recording, mixing and mastering studio in Yongsan, Seoul.
en.h1: Sound tools, and a recording studio run by an engineer
en.sub: Apps and web tools made by a working sound engineer, and a small studio for recording, mixing and mastering.

cards.title: Apps
cards.text: Exam prep for stage-sound certification, SPL and RTA measurement, ear training, DAW shortcuts and score conversion — built for real work.

cards.title: Plugins
cards.text: Audio plugins (VST3 and AU) are in the works.

cards.title: Studio
cards.text: Recording, mixing, mastering and stage sound, done by an engineer in a studio in Yongsan, Seoul.

en.tools_text: Use the RTA analyzer, signal generator, ear trainers and delay, acoustics, electrical and tempo calculators right in your browser.
en.trust: From 2009 to 2024: 111 recorded credits on albums, films and stage productions — recording, mixing, mastering and stage sound.
